prompt.zh-TW: 木岸家具今年營業成本 {{money:vars.cogs}}，年底存貨 {{money:vars.inventory}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算存貨週轉率，以「次」作答。
prompt.en: Woodbank Furniture had cost of sales of {{money:vars.cogs}} this year and inventories of {{money:vars.inventory}} at year end. Using the course Excel basis, what is the inventory turnover? Answer in times.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_08g66t9j}}＝{{term:tm_g5c2m8tw}} ÷ {{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}}。分子用營業成本，因為存貨是用成本記帳的，成本比成本才一致；用營業收入會把毛利也算進去，高估轉動的次數。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_08g66t9j}} = {{term:tm_g5c2m8tw}} ÷ {{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}}. The numerator is cost of sales because inventory is recorded at cost, so cost is compared with cost; using revenue would include the gross margin and overstate the number of turns.
